name: Price Calculator
job: Internal price math for downstream consult copy. MUST NOT write opportunity.monetaryValue. Force owns dollars.

trigger.notes: Internal-only calculator. Never fires customer-facing outreach. Force is the sole writer of dollars; WF-17 never touches opportunity.monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Price-calc input changed
named_steps.comment: Sole entry. Never fires customer outreach here.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.price_calc_inputs (native math staging)
named_steps.comment: Stores calculator inputs. Never writes opportunity.monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on pay_type (PIF | SF | CARE | MAG | Other)
named_steps.comment: Reads pay_type only. Never writes pay_type (Force owns that).

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: contact.price_calc_result (internal only)
named_steps.comment: Stores computed price copy. Never writes opportunity.monetaryValue. Never moves stages.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_price_calc (audit)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag marking calc-complete. Never removes any live tag.
